dispositions.reason: Row of the English convenience translation at Appendix B. Clause 7.2: 'The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' and AppB/para1: 'The Arabic text of Table 5-1 at Appendix A governs.' The insertion of Table 5-1 into Volume II is made by Clause 7.1, not by this row. Figures (1,500 m, 25 m, lighting required) agree with the Arabic image; but the column heading 'm above finished ground level' does not match the Arabic heading (natural ground level) - see the escalation on note(2).

Row of the English convenience translation. Clause 7.2: 'The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.' Insertion is by Clause 7.1. Figures (40 m; lighting for any part exceeding 30 m) agree with the Arabic image; column heading datum discrepancy as for row a.
Introductory words 'Notes to Table 5-1:' of the convenience translation; they print no change. Clause 7.2: 'provided for convenience only'.

Note of the convenience translation; the obligation 'The Office shall be notified at least thirty (30) days before any crane is erected at the site.' comes into Volume II through Clause 7.1 incorporating the Arabic Table 5-1, which governs (Clause 7.2: 'The Arabic text governs. The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.'). The Arabic note 3 prints the same 30 days.
